name: Export a WSL Distribution to a Backup File
description: Export a Windows Subsystem for Linux distribution to a tar file on a schedule, so a development environment that only exists inside WSL can be restored after a bad update or a lost disk. The export overwrites the file at the path you give.

parameters.label: Distribution name
parameters.help: The name shown by wsl --list, e.g. Ubuntu. The distribution is stopped briefly while it is exported.

parameters.label: Backup file path
parameters.help: Where to write the tar file. It is the size of the whole distribution, so choose a drive with room, and note that each run replaces the previous file.
